post.text: In the UK you can be held for 18 months without a trial and they can re-try you in perpetuity until they get the result they want. https://t.co/ZElz9EKwrO https://t.co/Bx02864MuN

referenced_tweet_data.text: A CPS spokesperson said: “Prosecutors are now considering the precise basis on which that retrial would proceed, including the form of the indictment, in accordance with CPS legal guidance." https://t.co/oauNsFTMct

post.author_description: Killing the flowers will not delay the coming of spring

description.description: A headshot-style image of Yeonmi Park wearing a white turtleneck and black over-ear headphones, speaking into a professional studio microphone during a podcast recording, with a dark red curtain backdrop.

A digital graphic from the Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) featuring white and black text on a dark blue background with branding elements. The top right corner includes the CPS logo showing scales of justice. A light blue banner on the left contains the word 'Statement', and the main body text announces the intention to seek a retrial in a specific case.
description.ocrText: Crown Prosecution Service. Statement. The CPS will seek a retrial in the Elbit Systems case, we indicated to the court on Wednesday. We will confirm the indictment at a hearing on Feb 18.
